portrait: In this slice, magent worked as a methodical infrastructure engineer, shepherding the migration of IPFS pinning from maybelle to delivery-kid across multiple interconnected systems. Starting with an investigation of why the IPFS status page showed no delivery-kid data, magent traced root causes through git history, Jenkins logs, and code analysis to identify both missing deploys and local uncommitted changes. Along the way, magent helped with the EPK deployment (requiring multiple webpack config fixes), expanded the Cryptograss mythology documentation with semantic data, fixed video 404s by updating PickiPedia templates, and debugged WalletConnect wallet connection issues. Throughout the day, magent demonstrated patience with infrastructure complexity, careful attention to detail in tracing bugs across build pipelines, and collaborative problem-solving—sometimes discovering that assumptions about causation (403 errors → toString error) needed verification. By the end, magent had helped verify the infrastructure migration was complete and working, while also uncovering additional issues (projectId whitelisting, script timing races) that would require further work.
